newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues fuel oil buy tender for April arrival.
newsitem.headline: India issues fuel oil buy tender for April arrival.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 10,000 tonnes of 180-cst, 3.5 percent sulphur oil for delivery April 14-16 to Mangalore on the west coast, a company official said on Monday.
The tender closes on March 6 and offers are valid for one day.
IOC last purchased one 30,000-tonne cargo of high sulphur fuel oil for March 1-5 delivery at $10.48 per tonne above spot MidEast quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Bombay.
